definitions.explanation: Made by hand rather than by machine or factory. Emphasizes the craftsmanship or personal effort involved in making something.

examples.japanese: {手製|てせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手製|てせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マフラー→マフラー：04533_mafuraa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
examples.english: The scarf my grandmother made by hand is warm.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ→一つ一つ：27163_hitotsuhitotsu⟧{手製|てせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げた→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧ものです。
examples.english: This bag was finished one by one by hand by a craftsman.

notes:
USAGE:
Functions as both a noun and a no-adjective. Carries a positive connotation of care and personal effort. Often used when describing gifts, food, or craft items made by a specific person. More formal than ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧, which is the more common everyday word for "handmade."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手製|てせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: handmade ~
- {手製|てせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧: handmade item
- {手製|てせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧: handmade sweets

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧: handmade (more casual, everyday usage)
- ⟦{自家製|じかせい}→自家製：13947_jikasei⟧: homemade, house-made (often used for food products)
